description:
The publishing schedule: slots from Pages per month, and every ready page on the schedule out on its day, live, exactly as written, whoever wrote it. A planned page there is written that morning by Sightkick if sightkickWrites is on; one of yours not written by its day goes back to Unscheduled as missed. A page without a day waits in Unscheduled.
action:
- place(articleId, at, date?): Put a page on the schedule or move it: at next (the next open slot) or day (that date, a slot or not, however many pages it already holds).
- unplace(articleId): Take a page off the schedule, to Unscheduled. Its status stays.
- set_slots(pagesPerMonth?, publishHour?): Pages per month (1 to 120, at least what Sightkick writes a month): its slots spread evenly over each month, 15 every second day, 30 daily. And the hour pages go out (6 to 23).
name: schedule_page
title: Schedule pages
